$comment: Design Engineering Toolkit CLI family — SemanticProjection. Major version 1. Explicit, reason-carrying human decision that assigns composer roles to OBSERVED design-source locators (issue #23 coordinator fidelity correction): source documents whose layer names/child types do not carry the SLOT-role naming convention (raw text names, button component instances, unlabeled decoration) stay RAW and faithful; this document — reviewed and pinned to the same source revision — is the auditable projection from observed locators to semantic roles. It never invents nodes, content or asset URLs, and every assignment must state its observed reason. Platform-neutral: roles are generic composition vocabulary, never platform identifiers. Version 1.3.0 (issue #25) additively extends the role vocabulary with the two-column composition roles column-primary / column-secondary (which observed slot containers become the native columns, primary first) and inline-media (which observed frames inside a column become native image elements).
title: Design Engineering Toolkit — Semantic Projection

profileId.description: Must equal the profile id of the run that produced the pinned PageStructure.

sourceRevisionId.description: Must equal PageStructure.source.revisionId — a projection is only valid for the observation it reviewed.

notes.description: Free-text context for reviewers; never parsed.

assignments.description: One assignment per source locator. Duplicate locators are a caller error (INPUT_CONTRACT_VIOLATION); the composer refuses to choose.

sourceLocator.description: The design:// locator of an observed node — exactly as carried by that node's pinned NodeIR evidence.

role.description: Generic composition role. decoration excludes the node AND its whole subtree from content (recorded, never silently dropped); cta resolves its label text from the content manifest; column-primary/column-secondary mark the two observed slot containers that become the native columns (primary first); inline-media marks an observed media frame inside a projected column that composes as a native image element.

reason.description: The observed fact this assignment rests on — a projection without a stated reason is not a reviewable decision.
